main_text.l: Anxities, perpetual Lamentations, feeble and fore broken, their
Strength dryed like a Potsheard, their Throat dry, their Tongue
cleaving to their Jaws, their Bowels boyling, their Bones burnt
with Heat, their Skin black upon them, their Flesh consumed,their
Bones sticking out, chastened with strong pain upon their Bed.
This is one of Satan's delightful Spectacles, and for these ends
doth he all he can, to bereave them of their Comfort, which
we may the more certainly perswade our selves to be true, when
